## Concrete revision and remaining boundaries

F1 proposal: one parent-owned P4 authorization/publication/occupancy COMMIT over actual waiting-child identity; no second current-authority/generation check in the child. The child consumes immutable one-shot dispatch evidence without acquiring home/seat, preserving signed committed-child continuation after transfer. New/delayed activation still freshly authorizes and retains strict unchanged-state refusal. The owner table states exact predicates, locks, writers, durable facts, pre/post-COMMIT failures, cancellation and recovery. It explicitly states the conflict if an exec-time current-authority policy is demanded instead.

F2 proposal: sealed memfd helper and native leaf, actual execveat descriptor execution, explicit FD/credential/parent-thread lifetime contract, trusted OS-loader boundary, and audited translation of the installed Node-to-native Codex wrapper. Arbitrary script/wrapper chains refuse before writes. Pane and containment adapters remain explicit missing positive-coverage obligations; no full gateway acceptance is claimed or silently reduced.

BUG-1808 owns the table/schema/publication/receipt substrate first. A transport-only WaitingChild/image/channel/cancellation slice can compile independently after different-advisor signoff, with production release unavailable absent the publisher-issued private CommittedDispatch. It alone satisfies neither spec. Callback-origin v5 remains separately authored, unsigned and required for Git publication; its files/mechanism were not edited or duplicated. BUG-1802 remains a later consumer; no circular dependency.

Fresh DIFFERENT independent signoff is required. No whole BUG-1808 approval before callback gate passes; no TASK-1607 production activation. Final authority-sensitive merge is Joe/operator-owned. Worker sandbox bypass provides no authority bypass.
